stages.title: controller export
stages.note: the program a control system plays, from the same Pulse MLIR

snapshots.label: Pulse MLIR: 21 operations
snapshots.say: The kernel as written: pulses, waits and syncs on its lines. It holds 21 operations.

snapshots.label: QOp: 82 operations
snapshots.say: QOp writes the pair's Hamiltonian and the Lindblad terms of its decay. It holds 82 operations.

snapshots.label: cuDensityMat: 122 operations
snapshots.say: The cuDensityMat dialect is the cuDensityMat API as IR. It holds 122 operations.

snapshots.label: LLVM IR: 1643 operations, 88 of them calls into cuDensityMat
snapshots.say: LLVM IR turns each of its operations into a call into the cuDensityMat runtime. It holds 1643 operations, 88 of them calls into cuDensityMat.

snapshots.label: Controller export: 5 events
snapshots.say: From the same Pulse MLIR, the program exports for a controller as 5 events. Only the last steps differ.
